title: Limited-range conversion adds its +16/255 offset to premultiplied-alpha overlay texels, which the ONE / ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA blend adds to the video
expected_finding: the overlay texture holds premultiplied colour and is blended with srcColor = ONE, but fragMain applies the straight-alpha limited-range mapping rgb * 219/255 + 16/255; transparent texels (rgb = 0, a = 0) output 16/255 and that is added to the video under the whole subtitle rectangle (the offset should be scaled by alpha for premultiplied input)
